description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of tests for Git object name disambiguation and revision parsing behavior. It sets up various repository states, triggers Git commands such as 'rev-parse' and 'log' with ambiguous object names, and checks for correct handling of ambiguities, type hints, and disambiguation options.

methods.name: test_cmp_failed_rev_parse
methods.description: Function to test that 'git rev-parse' with a given revision fails and produces expected error output with ambiguous object IDs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Function to run a set of commands and verify they succeed, with a descriptive message.

methods.name: test_expect_failure
methods.description: Function to run a set of commands expected to fail.
